// we cannot use libraries inside the claude code sandbox, hence this gross code


export type Frame = {
  shm: string
  format: 'rgba' | 'rgb'
  width: number
  height: number
  generation: number
  cols: number
  rows: number
}

export type BridgeState = {
  version: number
  frame: Frame | null
  title: string
  url: string | null
  alive: boolean
  error: string | null
  inbox: number
}

export type LaunchReport =
  | { port: number; token: string }
  | { error: string; code: 'tty' | 'start' }

export type SizeMessage = { type: 'size'; cols: number; rows: number }
export type InputMessage = { type: 'input'; events: unknown[] }

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => typeof value === 'object' && value !== null

export const isFrame = (value: unknown): value is Frame =>
  isRecord(value)
  && typeof value.shm === 'string'
  && (value.format === 'rgba' || value.format === 'rgb')
  && Number.isInteger(value.width)
  && Number.isInteger(value.height)
  && Number.isInteger(value.generation)
  && Number.isInteger(value.cols)
  && Number.isInteger(value.rows)

export const isBridgeState = (value: unknown): value is BridgeState =>
  isRecord(value)
  && Number.isInteger(value.version)
  && typeof value.alive === 'boolean'
  && 'frame' in value
  && (value.frame === null || isFrame(value.frame))

export const isLaunchReport = (value: unknown): value is LaunchReport =>
  isRecord(value) && (typeof value.port === 'number' || typeof value.error === 'string')

export const isSizeMessage = (data: unknown): data is SizeMessage =>
  isRecord(data) && data.type === 'size' && Number.isInteger(data.cols) && Number.isInteger(data.rows)

export const isInputMessage = (data: unknown): data is InputMessage =>
  isRecord(data) && data.type === 'input' && Array.isArray(data.events)

export type AgentText = { text: string; screenshot: string | null }

const isAgentText = (value: unknown): value is AgentText =>
  isRecord(value) && typeof value.text === 'string' && (value.screenshot === null || typeof value.screenshot === 'string')

export const takenItems = (value: unknown): AgentText[] =>
  isRecord(value) && Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.filter(isAgentText) : []

export const LINUX_LAUNCH = 'setsid -f -w "$@" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 1; kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; wait "$p"'

export const LINUX_OPEN = [
  'set -f',
  'f=$1',
  'if command -v gio >/dev/null; then',
  '  if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v file >/dev/null && encoding=$(file -b --mime-encoding -- "$f") && [ -n "$encoding" ] && [ "$encoding" != binary ]; then',
  '    case $(gio info -a standard::content-type -- "$f" | sed -n \'s/.*standard::content-type: //p\') in',
  '      video/* | audio/*)',
  '        app=$(xdg-mime query default text/plain)',
  '        IFS=:',
  '        for dir in "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}" ${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}; do',
  '          [ -n "$app" ] && [ -f "$dir/applications/$app" ] && exec gio launch "$dir/applications/$app" "$f"',
  '        done',
  '        echo "No text/plain desktop application found for $f" >&2',
  '        exit 1',
  '        ;;',
  '    esac',
  '  fi',
  '  if (exec gio open "$f"); then exit 0; fi',
  'fi',
  'exec xdg-open "$f"',
].join('\n')

export const TMUX_OPEN = [
  'f=$1 d=$2 n=$3; shift 3',
  'bin=$1',
  'case ${bin##*/} in nvim) ;; *) exec tmux new-window -c "$d" -- "$@" ${n:+"+$n"} "$f" ;; esac',
  'probe() {',
  '  "$bin" --server "$s" --remote-expr \'$TMUX . " " . $TMUX_PANE\' 2>/dev/null &',
  '  request=$!',
  '  (sleep 1; kill -KILL "$request") >/dev/null 2>&1 &',
  '  timer=$!',
  '  wait "$request" 2>/dev/null; result=$?',
  '  kill "$timer" 2>/dev/null',
  '  wait "$timer" 2>/dev/null',
  '  return "$result"',
  '}',
  'here=$(tmux display-message -p \'#{socket_path} #{session_id}\')',
  'best= act=-1',
  'for s in "${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/nonexistent}"/nvim.*.0 "${TMPDIR:-${TMP:-${TEMP:-/tmp}}}"/nvim."$(id -un)"/*/nvim.*.0; do',
  '  [ -S "$s" ] && [ -O "$s" ] || continue',
  '  t=$(probe) || continue',
  '  p=${t##* } sock=${t%%,*}',
  '  [ -n "$p" ] && [ "$sock" != "$t" ] || continue',
  '  info=$(tmux display-message -p -t "$p" \'#{socket_path} #{session_id} #{window_activity}\' 2>/dev/null) || continue',
  '  location=${info% *} activity=${info##* }',
  '  [ "$location" = "$here" ] && [ "${location% *}" = "$sock" ] && [ "$activity" -gt "$act" ] || continue',
  '  best=$s pane=$p act=$activity',
  'done',
  'if [ -n "$best" ] && "$bin" --server "$best" --remote "$f"; then',
  '  [ -z "$n" ] || "$bin" --server "$best" --remote-send "<C-\\><C-N>:$n<CR>"',
  '  exec tmux select-window -t "$pane" \\; select-pane -t "$pane"',
  'fi',
  'exec tmux new-window -c "$d" -- "$@" ${n:+"+$n"} "$f"',
].join('\n')

const WIN_OPEN = "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; [Diagnostics.Process]::Start([Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]@{ FileName = $env:PANE_OPEN_TARGET; UseShellExecute = $true }) | Out-Null"

export function tmuxOpenCommand(editor: string, target: string, line?: number) {
  const argv = words(editor)
  if (!argv[0]) throw new Error('Editor command is empty')
  const dir = target.slice(0, target.lastIndexOf('/')) || '/'
  return {
    argv: ['sh', '-c', TMUX_OPEN, 'sh', target, dir, line ? String(line) : '', ...argv],
    init: { timeoutMs: 10_000 },
  }
}

export function openCommand(os: 'linux' | 'darwin' | 'win32', target: string) {
  const argv = os === 'linux'
    ? ['sh', '-c', LINUX_LAUNCH, 'sh', 'sh', '-c', LINUX_OPEN, 'sh', target]
    : os === 'darwin'
      ? ['open', '--', target]
      : ['powershell', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', WIN_OPEN]
  return {
    argv,
    init: {
      timeoutMs: 10_000,
      ...(os === 'win32' ? { env: { PANE_OPEN_TARGET: /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(target) ? target : target.replace(/\//g, '\\') } } : {}),
    },
  }
}

function words(command: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  let word: string | null = null
  let quote = ''
  for (const ch of command) {
    if (quote) {
      if (ch === quote) quote = ''
      else word = (word ?? '') + ch
    } else if (ch === '"' || ch === "'") {
      quote = ch
      word ??= ''
    } else if (/\s/.test(ch)) {
      if (word !== null) out.push(word)
      word = null
    } else word = (word ?? '') + ch
  }
  if (word !== null) out.push(word)
  return out
}

export function openWithCommand(command: string, path: string, dir: string, line = 1): string[] | null {
  const argv = words(command)
  if (!argv.length) return null
  const filled = argv.map(w => w.replace(/\{(path|dir|line)\}/g, (_, key) => (key === 'path' ? path : key === 'dir' ? dir : String(line))))
  return argv.some(w => w.includes('{path}')) ? filled : [...filled, path]
}

export type Category = 'code' | 'config' | 'docs' | 'other'

// Extensions in EXTS that are not code; the rest of EXTS is code.
const CONFIG_EXTS = new Set(['json', 'jsonc', 'yaml', 'yml', 'toml', 'ini', 'conf', 'xml', 'lock'])
const DOCS_EXTS = new Set(['md', 'markdown', 'txt', 'pdf', 'csv'])
const MEDIA_EXTS = new Set(['svg', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp', 'mp4', 'mkv', 'mov', 'mp3', 'wav', 'flac', 'zip', 'gz', 'xz', 'tar'])

// A file named `constructor` is not the object's own constructor.
const own = (table: Record<string, number>, key: string): number | undefined => (Object.hasOwn(table, key) ? table[key] : undefined)

// The named files in NAMES are project config, except the docs among them. A dotfile
// or a Dockerfile variant with no known extension is config too.
export function fileCategory(name: string): Category {
  const lower = name.toLowerCase()
  if (own(NAMES, lower)) return lower === 'license' || lower.endsWith('.md') ? 'docs' : 'config'
  if (lower.startsWith('dockerfile')) return 'config'
  const dot = lower.lastIndexOf('.')
  const ext = dot > 0 ? lower.slice(dot + 1) : ''
  if (CONFIG_EXTS.has(ext)) return 'config'
  if (DOCS_EXTS.has(ext)) return 'docs'
  if (MEDIA_EXTS.has(ext) || !own(EXTS, ext)) return lower.startsWith('.') ? 'config' : 'other'
  return 'code'
}

export function fileIcon(n: FileNode, open: boolean, isRepo: boolean): string {
  if (n.kind === 'link') return cp(0xf481)
  if (n.kind === 'dir') return cp(isRepo ? 0xf02a2 : open ? 0xe5fe : 0xe5ff)
  const lower = n.name.toLowerCase()
  const named = own(NAMES, lower)
  if (named) return cp(named)
  const dot = lower.lastIndexOf('.')
  const ext = dot >= 0 ? lower.slice(dot + 1) : ''
  return cp(own(EXTS, ext) ?? 0xf0214)
}

export const GIT_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {

}

const PRIORITY = ['U', 'D', 'M', 'T', 'R', 'C', 'A', '?']

export function stronger(a: string | undefined, b: string): string {
  if (!a) return b
  return PRIORITY.indexOf(b) < PRIORITY.indexOf(a) ? b : a
}

import type { CalmSnapshot, Prefs } from '../types'

export const DEFAULT_PREFS: Prefs = {
  skin: 'pernambuco',
  icons: 'unicode',
  prompt: 'left',
  words: 'skin',
  rail: true,
  tables: 'on',
  shimmer: true,
  band: true,
  countdown: false,
  clipOutput: false,
  markdown: true,
  quiet: false,
  charts: true,
  math: true,
  commands: true,
  shell: true,
  highlight: true,
  hints: true,
  links: true,
  copy: true,
  fold: true,
  expand: false,
  compact: true,
  calm: null,
}

// The on/off settings, by the word /skin and the settings pane use for each. Tables have a
// third state, `text`, so they are switched on their own.
export const TOGGLES = {
  rail: 'rail',
  shimmer: 'shimmer',
  band: 'band',
  countdown: 'countdown',
  clip: 'clipOutput',
  markdown: 'markdown',
  quiet: 'quiet',
  charts: 'charts',
  math: 'math',
  commands: 'commands',
  shell: 'shell',
  highlight: 'highlight',
  hints: 'hints',
  links: 'links',
  copy: 'copy',
  fold: 'fold',
  expand: 'expand',
  compact: 'compact',
} as const satisfies Record<string, keyof Prefs>

export type ToggleWord = keyof typeof TOGGLES

export type Outcome = {
  prefs: Prefs
  message: string
  // `row` prints a transcript line (listings, mistakes); `toast` confirms a change quietly.
  channel: 'row' | 'toast'
}

const flagOr = (value: unknown, fallback: boolean): boolean =>
  typeof value === 'boolean' ? value : fallback

export const TABLE_MODES = ['on', 'text', 'off'] as const satisfies readonly Prefs['tables'][]

// Tables were on/off before `text`, so a stored boolean still reads.
export function tablesOr(value: unknown, fallback: Prefs['tables']): Prefs['tables'] {
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
    return value ? 'on' : 'off'
  }

  return TABLE_MODES.find(mode => mode === value) ?? fallback
}

// The settings pane's tables button steps through the modes in order.
export const nextTables = (mode: Prefs['tables']): Prefs['tables'] =>
  TABLE_MODES[(TABLE_MODES.indexOf(mode) + 1) % TABLE_MODES.length] ?? 'on'

// A stored calm snapshot, or null when it is not one: then calm reads as off.
function calmOf(value: unknown): CalmSnapshot | null {
  const saved = typeof value === 'object' && value !== null ? (value as Record<string, unknown>) : null

  return saved !== null && typeof saved.shimmer === 'boolean' && typeof saved.rail === 'boolean' && typeof saved.quiet === 'boolean'
    ? { shimmer: saved.shimmer, rail: saved.rail, quiet: saved.quiet }
    : null
}

// What the store hands back may be old, hand-edited or from another version.
export function parsePrefs(raw: unknown, names: readonly string[]): Prefs {
  const saved = typeof raw === 'object' && raw !== null ? (raw as Record<string, unknown>) : {}
  const skin = saved.skin

  return {
    skin:
      typeof skin === 'string' && (skin === 'off' || names.includes(skin))
        ? skin
        : DEFAULT_PREFS.skin,
    icons: saved.icons === 'ascii' ? 'ascii' : 'unicode',
    prompt: saved.prompt === 'right' || saved.prompt === 'plain' ? saved.prompt : 'left',
    words: saved.words === 'claude' ? 'claude' : 'skin',
    rail: flagOr(saved.rail, DEFAULT_PREFS.rail),
    tables: tablesOr(saved.tables, DEFAULT_PREFS.tables),
    shimmer: flagOr(saved.shimmer, DEFAULT_PREFS.shimmer),
    band: flagOr(saved.band, DEFAULT_PREFS.band),
    countdown: flagOr(saved.countdown, DEFAULT_PREFS.countdown),
    clipOutput: flagOr(saved.clipOutput, DEFAULT_PREFS.clipOutput),
    markdown: flagOr(saved.markdown, DEFAULT_PREFS.markdown),
    quiet: flagOr(saved.quiet, DEFAULT_PREFS.quiet),
    charts: flagOr(saved.charts, DEFAULT_PREFS.charts),
    math: flagOr(saved.math, DEFAULT_PREFS.math),
    commands: flagOr(saved.commands, DEFAULT_PREFS.commands),
    shell: flagOr(saved.shell, DEFAULT_PREFS.shell),
    highlight: flagOr(saved.highlight, DEFAULT_PREFS.highlight),
    hints: flagOr(saved.hints, DEFAULT_PREFS.hints),
    links: flagOr(saved.links, DEFAULT_PREFS.links),
    copy: flagOr(saved.copy, DEFAULT_PREFS.copy),
    fold: flagOr(saved.fold, DEFAULT_PREFS.fold),
    expand: flagOr(saved.expand, DEFAULT_PREFS.expand),
    compact: flagOr(saved.compact, DEFAULT_PREFS.compact),
    calm: calmOf(saved.calm),
  }
}

// /skin calm: no motion, one line per tool row, read-only output folded. What it changes is
// kept, so calm off puts back what was there before. Failures stay whole either way
// (register.tsx draws them past quiet while calm is on).
export function withCalm(current: Prefs, on: boolean): Prefs {
  if (on) {
    return current.calm !== null
      ? current
      : { ...current, calm: { shimmer: current.shimmer, rail: current.rail, quiet: current.quiet }, shimmer: false, rail: false, quiet: true }
  }

  return current.calm === null ? current : { ...current, ...current.calm, calm: null }
}

const changed = (prefs: Prefs, message: string): Outcome => ({ prefs, message, channel: 'toast' })

const refused = (prefs: Prefs, message: string): Outcome => ({ prefs, message, channel: 'row' })

const onOff = (on: boolean): string => (on ? 'on' : 'off')

export const listing = (current: Prefs, names: readonly string[]): string =>
  [
    ...names.map(name => `${name === current.skin ? '●' : '○'} ${name}`),
    `${current.skin === 'off' ? '●' : '○'} off`,
    [
      `icons ${current.icons}`,
      `prompt ${current.prompt}`,
      `words ${current.words}`,
      `rail ${onOff(current.rail)}`,
      `tables ${current.tables}`,
      `shimmer ${onOff(current.shimmer)}`,
      `band ${onOff(current.band)}`,
      `clip ${onOff(current.clipOutput)}`,
      `markdown ${onOff(current.markdown)}`,
      `quiet ${onOff(current.quiet)}`,
      `charts ${onOff(current.charts)}`,
      `math ${onOff(current.math)}`,
      `commands ${onOff(current.commands)}`,
      `shell ${onOff(current.shell)}`,
      `highlight ${onOff(current.highlight)}`,
      `hints ${onOff(current.hints)}`,
      `links ${onOff(current.links)}`,
      `copy ${onOff(current.copy)}`,
      `fold ${onOff(current.fold)}`,
      `expand ${onOff(current.expand)}`,
      `compact ${onOff(current.compact)}`,
      `calm ${onOff(current.calm !== null)}`,
    ].join(' · '),
  ].join('\n')

const isToggle = (word: string): word is ToggleWord => Object.hasOwn(TOGGLES, word)

// Every argument but none: with none, /skin opens the settings pane instead.
export function runSkinCommand(args: string, current: Prefs, names: readonly string[]): Outcome {
  const [head = '', value] = args.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/)

  if (isToggle(head)) {
    const field = TOGGLES[head]

    return value === 'on' || value === 'off'
      ? changed({ ...current, [field]: value === 'on' }, `${head} ${value}`)
      : refused(current, `uso: /skin ${head} on|off`)
  }

  switch (head) {
    case 'list':
      return refused(current, listing(current, names))
    // `default` and `stock` are what people reach for when they want Claude Code's own look.
    case 'off':
    case 'default':
    case 'stock':
      return changed({ ...current, skin: 'off' }, 'skin desligada')
    case 'on':
      return current.skin === 'off'
        ? changed({ ...current, skin: DEFAULT_PREFS.skin }, `skin: ${DEFAULT_PREFS.skin}`)
        : changed(current, `skin: ${current.skin}`)
    case 'calm':
      return value === 'on' || value === undefined
        ? changed(withCalm(current, true), current.calm === null ? 'calm on' : 'calm já está ligado')
        : value === 'off'
          ? changed(withCalm(current, false), current.calm === null ? 'calm já está desligado' : 'calm off: suas configurações voltaram')
          : refused(current, 'uso: /skin calm [on|off]')
    case 'tables':
      return value === 'on' || value === 'text' || value === 'off'
        ? changed({ ...current, tables: value }, `tables ${value}`)
        : refused(current, 'uso: /skin tables on|text|off')
    case 'prompt':
      return value === 'left' || value === 'right' || value === 'plain'
        ? changed({ ...current, prompt: value }, `prompt ${value}`)
        : refused(current, 'uso: /skin prompt left|right|plain')
    case 'words':
      return value === 'claude' || value === 'skin'
        ? changed({ ...current, words: value }, `words: ${value}`)
        : refused(current, 'uso: /skin words claude|skin')
    case 'icons':
      return value === 'unicode' || value === 'ascii'
        ? changed({ ...current, icons: value }, `icons: ${value}`)
        : refused(current, 'uso: /skin icons unicode|ascii')
    default:
      return names.includes(head)
        ? changed({ ...current, skin: head }, `skin: ${head}`)
        : refused(current, `skin "${head}" desconhecida. /skin list mostra as skins`)
  }
}

import { TOKENS } from '../pe/ds.generated'
import type { Palette, Skin } from '../skin'

// The Liga Digital color tokens (@uigovpe/styles). Text, status and surfaces use the
// semantic tokens; the tool kinds, which the design system has no names for, use its
// primitive scale: light shades on a dark terminal, strong ones on a light terminal.
// No two slots that show as text share a colour, and each one reads at 4.5:1 or more.
const token = (scheme: 'light' | 'dark', name: string): string => {
  const value = TOKENS[scheme][name]
  if (value === undefined) throw new Error(`pernambuco skin: no token ${name} in the ${scheme} theme`)
  return value
}

const dark = (name: string) => token('dark', name)
const light = (name: string) => token('light', name)

// Halfway between two tokens, for the one shade the dark theme lacks: a grey that is
// dimmer than the text but still reads (placeholder #ced2d7 is too bright, disabled too dim).
const mix = (a: string, b: string): string =>
  `#${[1, 3, 5].map(i => Math.round((parseInt(a.slice(i, i + 2), 16) + parseInt(b.slice(i, i + 2), 16)) / 2).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`

const palette: Palette = {
  read: dark('--color-light-blue-softer'),
  write: dark('--color-light-yellow-default'),
  run: dark('--color-light-green-soft'),
  search: dark('--color-light-red-softer'),
